title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Mark 3: the man with the withered hand, the choosing of the twelve, the charge that he had Beelzebul and his words about his true family.

questions.text: What was wrong with the man in the synagogue?
questions.explanation: Mark 3:1 says that when he entered the synagogue again, there was a man there who had his hand withered.

answers.text: He was blind from birth
He could not hear or speak
He was lame in both feet
His hand was withered

questions.text: What happened when the man stretched out his hand?
questions.explanation: He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

answers.text: It stayed withered until the next day
It was restored as healthy as the other
It was wrapped in cloth and healed slowly
He could move only his fingers

questions.text: With whom did the Pharisees conspire against Jesus?
questions.explanation: The Pharisees went out and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

answers.text: The Herodians
The Sadducees
The soldiers of the governor
The rulers of Tyre and Sidon

questions.text: What did the unclean spirits cry out whenever they saw him?
questions.explanation: The unclean spirits fell down before him and cried, "You are the Son of God!"

answers.text: "You are the king of Israel!"
"You are the prophet of Galilee!"
"You are the Son of God!"
"You are the son of David!"

questions.text: Why did Jesus appoint the twelve?
questions.explanation: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him and that he might send them out to preach, with authority to heal sicknesses and cast out demons.

answers.text: To guard him from the crowds
To collect money for the poor
To keep the tradition of the elders
To be with him and to be sent out to preach

questions.text: What name did Jesus give to James and John?
questions.explanation: He called them Boanerges, which means Sons of Thunder.

answers.text: Cephas
Boanerges
Sons of Light
Didymus

questions.text: What did his friends say when they went out to seize him?
questions.explanation: His friends went out to seize him, for they said, "He is insane."

answers.text: "He is a prophet."
"He is in danger."
"He is insane."
"He is our brother."

questions.text: What did the scribes who came down from Jerusalem say about him?
questions.explanation: They said, "He has Beelzebul," and that he casts out the demons by the prince of the demons.

answers.text: That he casts out demons by the prince of the demons
That he learned his teaching in Egypt
That he was John risen from the dead
That he taught against Moses

questions.text: What did Jesus say about a house divided against itself?
questions.explanation: He said that if a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

answers.text: It will be plundered by Satan
It cannot stand
It will be forgiven everything
It will be built up again

questions.text: Whom did Jesus call his brother, sister and mother?
questions.explanation: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said that whoever does the will of God is his brother, sister and mother.

answers.text: Those who were born in his own country
The twelve he had just appointed
Those who had been healed by him
Whoever does the will of God
